name: No one knows you better
source:
She’s always there to help you out.

She’s seen everything you’ve been through.

No one knows you better than she does.

No one, not even you.

That’s why you should listen to her.

That’s the least you can do.

[From [url=https://moebuddha.itch.io/no-one-knows-you-better]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她总会在你身边向你伸出援手。

你所经历的一切，她全都看在眼里。

世上没有人比她更了解你。

没有任何人，哪怕是你自己。

所以你理应听她的话。

这至少是你力所能及的回报。

[摘自[url=https://moebuddha.itch.io/no-one-knows-you-better]itch.io[/url]]
